item.title: Show-Me Network expands no-cost support for Missouri entrepreneurs
item.description: The Show-Me Network, led by efactory and Codefi, is a statewide initiative that provides entrepreneurs with free resources, training, and professional guidance to help them overcome common barriers to starting and growing a business.
